deedglass.assumes: Through the Gate with the postgres-safe starter policy. The other path is the same commands from a shell (outside the Gate), with observe mode watching public.customers.
deedglass.outside_gate: A DROP writes no row changes, so a watched session records only the 3 inserts. Dropping a watched table takes it out of the publication, which stops the decoder; later actions on the connector get the gap decoder_halted (UNVERIFIABLE), never VERIFIED.
deedglass.note: Through the Gate each statement is its own action: the DROP and both CREATEs are denied, and the seed INSERT runs and fails (the 500 rows are still there, so ids 1 to 3 are taken). Nothing committed.
